title: ઘરે બધાને લાગ્યું, બધું ઠીક છે
banner:
નોકરી ગઈ, પણ ઘર પર
'બધું મજામાં છે' 😶
caption:
રોહને કોઈને ના કહ્યું. પછી એક રાત, નામ વગર, લખી દીધું. 👇
એક સાચ, નામ વગર: Waypoint, બાયોમાં લિંક. 18+
linkedin_text: A short illustrated story in Hindi about a young man who loses his job and tells his family everything is fine, until he finds one place to say the truth without his name. Waypoint is free on Google Play, for adults 18 and over.

art.style: Warm hand-painted Indian storybook illustration, soft gouache and watercolour texture, golden-hour lighting, rich detailed everyday Indian settings, expressive faces, gentle nostalgic mood.

cast.Rohan: Rohan is a 27-year-old Indian man with short black hair, a light stubble, a plain blue shirt and a backpack; an honest tired face.
cast.Maa: Maa is Rohan's mother, a kind Indian woman in her fifties in a green cotton saree, hair in a bun, reading glasses on a chain.
cast.fox: The fox mascot is a friendly small orange fox with big kind eyes and a teal scarf, standing on two legs like a storybook character.

scenes.vo: રોહણની નોકરી જતી રહી, એક સોમવારે.
scenes.sub: રોહણની નોકરી જતી રહી, એક સોમવારે.
scenes.art: Rohan walks out of a glass office building on a grey morning carrying a small cardboard box with a plant and a mug, other people rushing past him, his face blank and tired.

scenes.vo: સાંજે મમ્મીનો ફોન, કામ કેવું ચાલે છે?
scenes.sub: સાંજે મમ્મીનો ફોન, કામ કેવું ચાલે છે?
scenes.art: Rohan sits by the window of a crowded city bus at dusk holding his phone to his ear, forcing a small smile while his eyes look sad, city lights blurring outside.
Close view of Rohan's face lit by his phone in a dim rented room, a cheerful fake smile on his lips and worry in his eyes, the cardboard box from the office still unopened on the floor.
Rohan lies on his bed at night scrolling his phone, floating chat bubbles around him show confetti, a trophy, a new car and a 'promoted!' badge, his own face dull in the blue light.
